narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='m1'/>One hundred squared wins, because one hundred is so much bigger than two.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>The base is bigger, but the exponent is tiny.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>Repeated doubling grows faster than we expect, so let us test it.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble shows 100 is bigger than 2; the small 2 over 100 and the big 100 over 2 glow; the bubble is struck in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>To check, write each side as a plain number when it is small.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>When one side is huge, compare it with a power you can work out.
removed_beats.on_screen: the check line work out small powers appears; the check line compare with a power you know appears

old_misconception.wrong_move: Chintu says one hundred squared wins, because one hundred is so much bigger than two. Two to the power fourteen already beats it, so the slip fails.
